title: Connection Settings
mockNote: Running outside the Wails runtime, so mock data is shown (anything you save is lost on reload).

firstRun.title: Welcome
firstRun.line1: There is no setting to connect to Backlog yet.
firstRun.line2: Please register your first connection profile.

form.name: Profile name
form.spaceUrlHint: Only *.backlog.jp / *.backlog.com URLs starting with https:// can be used.
form.apiKeyHint: The key cannot be shown again after it is saved.
form.apiKeyHintEdit: Leave it blank to keep the current key.

test.adminAvailable: Administrator features are expected to be available
test.adminUnavailable: Administrator features are expected to be unavailable (fetching users and teams falls back to per-project)
test.provisionalNote: This permission status is a provisional judgement based on the role (roleType). The confirmed status is checked with an actual API call after saving.

delete.title: Delete the profile
delete.confirmNote: The API key stored in the OS keychain is deleted as well. Are you sure?
delete.keepLocalWarning: If you clear this checkbox, the fetched data (which may contain personal information) stays on this computer.

error.saveActiveProfile: Failed to save the active connection: {message}
